name: Math — Lines & Angles
description: MATH · single module · 22 original Lines & Angles questions, difficulty rising Q1→Q22 (7 easy, 5 medium, 10 hard). Mixed multiple-choice and short answer. Topic: lines and angles only.

questions.question:

What is the measure, in degrees, of the other angle?

What is the measure of the other angle?

What is the measure, in degrees, of the angle vertical (directly opposite) to it?

What is the measure of angle BOC?

What is the measure of the other corresponding angle?

What is the measure, in degrees, of the third angle?

What is the measure of the other?

What is the value of x?

What is the measure, in degrees, of angle DOC?

How many of the eight angles measure 118°?

What is the measure of the angle?
